text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos seized the crown in the Takarazuka 
Kinen. With a performance praised by 
Satono Crown and the others, Dubai is 
finally becoming a tangible reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, Cheval Grand challenges 
Vivlos to a showdown at the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I trained so much until I could proudly 
call myself Vivlos's big sister. Now, as 
an older sister, I can finally lend her my 
back—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Accepting those feelings, Vivlos gladly 
accepted the declaration of rivalry. 
Savoring the happiness of having her 
family together again, she set her sights 
on the Japan Cup.
